_comment: Frozen baseline of pre-existing silent-fallback findings as of 2026-10-04 -- see gh-605. NOT individually allowlisted; check-no-stubs.sh treats any finding matching {rule_id, path, line_hash} here as known debt (non-fatal) and fails ONLY on findings outside this set. line_hash = sha256(stripped matched line text)[:16], survives line-number drift from unrelated edits above a finding.

entries.justification: Sanctioned graceful degradation (critical-rules.md Feature Flags & License Tiers): tier() fails open to the lowest license tier ("free") when the WIT flags import is unavailable (host-side tests) or stale-world (component wizened before the import existed) -- never crashes, never silently grants a higher tier. See module docstring.

Sanctioned graceful degradation (critical-rules.md Feature Flags & License Tiers): _license_tier() fails CLOSED to "free" (never "enterprise") when the WIT flags import is unavailable or stale-world -- same defensive shape as waddle_sdk.flask_core.feature_flags.tier(). Never overridable by env var/flag per license-tier rules. See function docstring.
